methodology.legacy_expiry_treatment: retained in all-closed research metrics but excluded from strict 24h validation
methodology.strict_24h_policy: closed duration must be known and no more than 24h plus one 5m candle; EXPIRED rows must use 5m_expiry_boundary
methodology.r_definition: price move divided by absolute entry-to-SL risk
methodology.pnl_basis: recorded pnl_pct less one entry and one exit fee
methodology.drawdown_basis: additive cumulative trade-return percentage points; not account-equity drawdown
methodology.risk_fallback: when initial_risk is missing, infer abs(entry - stop_loss); unrecoverable records are excluded from R statistics
